transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ___. What brings you in today?

Um... I was told to come in. It's... well, it's about work. Dispatch and compliance, they've been tracking my route changes. Through the computer system. And... there are these little comments on the radio. 

Everyone keeps saying it’s just normal oversight, but... I can just tell certain drivers are reporting on me. That's all.
Have you had periods of needing much less sleep than usual and still feeling full of energy?
No. I sleep fine. Just the normal amount.
Did these concerns start after a head injury or other medical problem?
No. I've never had a head injury or anything like that. I'm physically healthy.
Have you been feeling unusually high, excited, or irritable lately?
No. I don't... I don't feel like that. Just normal, I guess.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
No. Um... no. I don't hear anything like that.
How long have you been noticing these concerns?
Um... maybe about eight months? It... it started around the time they made me the temporary dispatch lead at work. I guess it's just been building up since then.
Before this started, would you say you’ve generally been a very suspicious or mistrustful person for most of your adult life?
No. Um... I don't think so. I usually just... keep to myself, mostly. I didn't really have a reason to not trust people before.
Have you noticed any changes in your thinking or behavior that other people have pointed out as odd or unusual?

Um... I guess at work, sometimes. People look at me like... like I'm being difficult. But I'm not. I just... I get stuck sometimes, rearranging the magnets and the route slips. They need to be in a certain pattern. Or I might repeat a driver's last few words back before I answer them. They think it's weird, but... I'm really just trying to keep the whole board from going wrong.
Do other people ever have trouble following the way you speak?
Um... I don't think so. I don't really talk to people that much anyway. Just... what I need to for work. So, no, they haven't said anything.
Have you noticed a drop in your work performance or ability to keep up with everyday responsibilities since this started?

Um... yeah, I guess. At work, I'm... I'm behind on the route reports. And some of the drivers have been complaining that my instructions are confusing. I don't know. And at home... my husband is doing mostly everything now. The meals, making calls... all the planning. I just... I haven't been keeping up with it.
Do you believe the radio comments and route tracking are definitely being directed at you by other people?

Um... yes. I mean, dispatch and compliance... they track my route changes through the computer system. And those little comments on the radio. People try to tell me it's just normal oversight, but... it's not. I can just tell that certain drivers are reporting on me.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being inserted into your mind, taken out of your mind, or broadcast so other people could hear them?
Um... no. I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. My thoughts are just mine. Nobody else can hear them.
Have you become more socially withdrawn or less interested in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I suppose so. I just... I don't really feel like singing with the choir anymore. Or having the softball team over. I just stay in. Most days after my shift, I just sit at the kitchen table. I'll have the planner open, but... I don't know, I just can't make myself start dinner, or make calls, or... anything, really. I just sit there.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um... no, not really. I wouldn't say depressed. Just... tired, I guess.
Have you had any new medical problems or changes in your health around the time these symptoms started?
Um... no. I don't think so. Not that I've noticed. I'm physically fine, I guess.
Have you ever had seizures?
No. Never anything like that.
Before these past eight months, had you generally been suspicious of other people or felt that they might be talking about you for most of your adult life?
Um... no. Not really. I usually just... keep to myself, so I don't think I paid much attention to what other people were doing back then.
Have you ever had periods in the past when you believed others were trying to harm or watch you, before the last eight months?
No... I haven't. Nothing like that before.
Have you had any hallucinations, like seeing things that aren’t there?
No... I haven't seen anything like that. Just normal things.
Do you think there’s any chance that your concerns about the radio comments and route tracking could be mistaken?

No... I don't think so. I know people keep saying it’s just... normal oversight. But I can tell. Dispatch and compliance... they track my route changes through the computer system. And I hear those little comments on the radio. I just know certain drivers are reporting on me. So... no. I'm not mistaken.
